title: Status properties/BringIntoCombat
html:
See also Status properties.

BringIntoCombat is a status property.

List of conditions with BringIntoCombat

Condition Effects
Ability Drain: Charisma
  • Charisma reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Dexterity
  • Dexterity reduced by  Ability Drain
Ability Drain: Intelligence
  • Intelligence reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Strength
  • Strength reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Wisdom
  • Wisdom reduced by  Ability Drain.
Bane
  • Has a -1d4 penalty to  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
Cheater's Folly
  • Affected entity has all Ability Scores reduced by 1 for attacking a reflection that's not their own. This effect can be applied thrice more.
Cloud of Daggers
  • Takes 4d4⁠⁠Slashing per turn.
  • This damage is increased by 2d4⁠⁠Slashing for for each spell slot level above 2nd used to cast  Cloud of Daggers.
Confused
  • Affected entity is hostile to everyone, wanders around aimlessly, and occasionally skips turns in its stupor
Crown of Madness
  • Instilled with magical madness. Will attack the nearest creature, other than the spellcaster.
Demonspirit Madness
  • Affected entity has been driven to a frenzy by magical madness. It will attack the nearest creature on its turn.
  • At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a  Wisdom Saving Throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.
Eyebite: Sickened
  • Affected entity has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Checks
Fetid Aura
  • All nearby creatures fall victim to the ooze's Fetid Fumes and 1d6⁠⁠Acid per turn.
Flaming Aura
  • Creature is standing within 1.5 m (5 ft) of a flaming sphere and will take 2d6⁠⁠Fire at the end of its turn. On a successful save, it will still take half damage.
Flaming Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the sphere at end of their turn take 2d6⁠⁠Fire damage. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
Fractured Psyche
  • Your  Armour Class is reduced by 5 and you have a -5 penalty to  Saving Throws.
Fractured Psyche
  •  Armour Class and  Saving Throws are reduced by 1.
Garrotted
  • Affected entity is being strangled by a garrotte. It is Silenced and takes 3d6⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn.
  • Both the entity and the garrotter can't move until the condition ends.
  • If the entity and the garrotter are forcibly moved more than 5 m (17 ft) apart, this condition ends.
Glimpse of Freedom
  • Escaping certain death, the character is motivated to move 4.5 m (15 ft) quicker.
Harm
  • Affected entity's maximum Hit Points have been reduced by the damage inflicted by the Harm spell
  • This condition is a Disease
Hellfire Curse
  • Hellfire roiling within this creature gives it  Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving Throws.
Hellish Sphere
  • Creature is standing within 3 m (10 ft) of a flaming sphere and will take 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage at the end of its turn. On a second save, it will still take half damage.
  • Dexterity save, based on the user's Wisdom Spell Save DC.
Hellish Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 3 m (10 ft) of the sphere at the end of their turn take 6d6⁠⁠Fire. On a successful save, they still take half damage.
Hexblade's Curse
  • Cursed by a Hexblade warlock. The warlock who cursed this entity adds their proficiency bonus to damage rolls against them. The number they need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking this entity is also reduced by 1.
Hexed: Charisma
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.
Hexed: Constitution
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.
Hexed: Dexterity
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.
Hexed: Intelligence
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.
Hexed: Strength
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks.
Hexed: Wisdom
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.
Houndmaster's Prey
  • Affected entity receives -3 to its Armour Class
  • When a Houndmaster's dog (Zina, Gordis, Rocky) hits the target, it gains  Prey Essence, gaining 30 Temporary Hit Points.
Hunger of Hadar
  • A sphere of cold blackness, teeming with unknown horrors.
  • Creatures starting their turn in the area take 2d6⁠⁠Cold. Creatures ending their turn in the area possibly take 2d6⁠⁠Acid.
  • The area is  Difficult Terrain, and creatures within are  Blinded.
Hunter's Mark Quarry
  • Affected entity suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Weapon damage if the spellcaster hits it with a weapon attack.
Insect Plague
  • Swarming, biting locusts fill the air. They deal 4d10⁠⁠Piercing per turn, make the area  Difficult Terrain, and impose  Disadvantage on Perception Checks.
Lured
  • The affected entity is attracted to a harpy's luring melody and uses its turn to move closer to the harpy, possibly provoking opportunity attacks from the other harpies.
  • The affected entity must pass a  DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of their turn or remain lured.
  • Taking damage or being Shoved removes the condition.
Madness
  • Hostile to everyone in the vicinity.
Moonbeam
  • Ghostly flames engulf any creature that enters this silvery light or starts its turn inside the light. They deal 2d10⁠⁠Radiant. On a successful save, targets still take half damage.
Moonbeam
  • Creature is engulfed by ghostly flames that inflict 2~20⁠⁠Radiant damage per turn. On a successful save, the creature still takes half damage.
Moonfire
  • The blessing of Dame Aylin's divine mother deals 2d10⁠⁠Radiant to foes that come within 3 m (10 ft) of her or start their turn there.
Murderous Dagger Cloud
  • Takes 6d4⁠⁠Piercing per turn.
Necrotic Aura
  • Gale exudes Necrotic energy. Nearby creatures take 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic every turn.
Noxious Fumes
  • Hostile creatures in a radius of 3 m (10 ft) take 1d4⁠⁠AcidDRS damage.
Otherworldly Miasma
  • Weakened by alien fumes. Vulnerable to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
Otherworldly Miasma
  • Alien fumes have hardened this githyanki's skin. It is resistant to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
Phantasmal Force

Haunted by an echo of the last thing that attacked them.

  • Takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage each turn.
  • When the target takes damage from another source, Phantasmal Force changes to that damage type.
  • At the end of each turn, the target makes an  Intelligence Saving Throw. On a success, the condition ends.
Rampart Aura
  • All entities with or in this aura have their movement speed halved.
Sapping Curse

This cursed energy drains vitality of anyone who dares get closer.

  • Any creature within range of the affected entity gains the condition Vitality Drain, and takes 4d6+4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding  DC 8 Wisdom Saving Throw.
  • Target is cursed.
Searing Smite
  • Takes 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • The condition ends if target succeeds a Constitution  Saving Throw.
Shar-Stricken
  • The Lady of Loss  Hexes you, causing a temporary lapse in your agility.
Shattered Psyche
  •  Armour Class and  Saving Throws are reduced by 2.
Shattered Psyche
  • Your  Armour Class is reduced by 6, you have a -5 penalty to all  Saving Throws, and  Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.
Shocking Grasp
  • Cannot take Reactions.
Singing Sword: Shriek
  • Affected entity has 1d4 penalty to all[See: Bugs]  Saving Throws and  Attack Rolls. When it is damaged, it takes an additional 1d4⁠⁠Thunder damage.
Singing Sword: Shrieking
  • Enemies within 6 m (20 ft) of range have 1d4 penalty to all[See: Bugs]  Saving Throws and  Attack Rolls and take an additional 1d4⁠⁠Thunder damage.
Spirit Guardians Aura
  • Spirits protect the affected entity, damaging enemies within 3 m (10 ft) and halving their movement speed.
  • Damage dealt is 3d8⁠⁠Radiant or 3d8⁠⁠Necrotic plus 1d8 per upcast level.
  • Targets succeeding a  Wisdom Saving Throw take half damage.
  • The caster can't become  Invisible while concentrating on this spell.
Static Discharge Aura
  • All constructs near Bernard deal an additional 2d4⁠⁠Lightning to weapon attacks. All others take 2d8⁠⁠Lightning each turn.
  • When the condition ends, Bernard is  Stunned for 2 turns.
The Wasting Quiet
  • Any creatures within this miasma of childlike terror are  Silenced and take 3d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage every time they enter or start their turn inside.
Vitality Drain

The dead girl's Sapping Curse is draining your vitality.

  • Affected entity takes takes 4d6+4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn. Take half damage on succeeding a  DC 8 Wisdom Saving Throw.
  • Doubled movement cost.
Wall of Fire
  • A blazing wall of fire that deals 5d8⁠⁠Fire to anyone within 3 m (10 ft).
Wall of Thorns
  • Walking through a wall of pliable, twisted thorns.
  • While within the wall, the affected entity's movement speed is quartered, and it takes 7d8⁠⁠Piercing damage per turn.
Wild Magic: Burning
  • Takes 1d6⁠⁠Fire damage at the start of each turn.
